$comment: The props of Idle (lvgl-switch.md §2.1): what views/idle-props.mjs gives the face, with props.idle true and no frame but the one line. Props name what, never where: the people of the living window (a seed each), the bed, the painting's slot and the line; no rectangle, no measure, no layout rule, no colour (the face reads those from frame.json idle). Checked by prototypes/station/tests/idle-props.test.mjs (a JSON-Schema subset).

curl.description: T-20261018-235: the sleeping resident's curl picture, set while its rest is asleep and it has a curl

curlFigure.description: [dx, dy, W, H] of the curl in its picture: the ring and the tag of a sleeping resident are measured from it

figure.description: T-20261018-235: [dx, dy, W, H], the drawn bbox of the figure (ink alpha >= 128, its contact shadow left out) in its picture; the ring, the tag, the walk and the keep-out are measured from it. Absent: the picture is the figure

moving.description: Station M1 §2.2: "" (a still, main's walk) or the atlases of its moving set (the walk and its shadow; a bed sleeper its nap); the face never makes an id

rest.description: Station M1 §2.6: by restOf (the rest stagger) from the Station time

shown.description: R4b (vivarium.json rules.show): false for a rester, one of the housed that the room does not show; absent: shown. A rester finishes its trip, then rests where restAt says; N for the raised cap and the travelling ceiling counts the shown only

restAt.description: R4b: where a rester rests, in the order rules.show.where gives: the bed (it is also in bed.sleepers), a curl in a nice spot (its curl and curlFigure given), or out of sight off the room's rest edge

enter.description: R4b: a traveller home since the walk began: it walks in from the room's rest edge (rooms.json rest.edge); honoured only while a walk is running

rester.description: R4b: a bed sleeper that is a rester (the bed is the nappers' alone)

id.description: the room shown: its name in rooms.json (roots, reeds, boulders, ferns)

base.description: the room's painting (the near view in Habitat) in the light

pieces.description: the room's pieces that have a picture, by piece id (rooms.json), the picture id in the light; Habitat has none

bed.description: given only when the room has a bed (Roots)
